infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Kudya Parceiro uses your location so drivers can share live GPS for deliveries and rides, and so partners can set accurate business and property locations.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Kudya Parceiro needs camera access to upload product photos, documents, and profile images.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Kudya Parceiro needs photo library access to upload product photos, documents, and profile images.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: Kudya Parceiro may save images to your photo library when you export or download documents.
